name: cabinet
description: The staff who read your board every morning: six roles with their own remits, memory and standing questions, a chief-of-staff brief capped at five one-way-door decisions, and a money invariant enforced by tool grants so no agent can spend.

interface.shortDescription: The staff who read your board every morning
interface.longDescription: Six roles with real remits and their own memory — delivery, architecture, QA, counsel, finance and brand. Each asks a standing question every run, proposes improvements nobody asked for, and learns how you decide. Only one-way-door decisions reach you, and no agent can spend your money.
